verdict.rationale: Heap's homepage markets Sense Chat as an in-product chat that lets users skip the learning curve and "go straight to insights," which points to a first-party conversational insight feature. This is only one marketing line, and it does not explicitly describe AI-generated analysis or proactive suggestions. Missing for 10: documentation explaining how Sense Chat generates insights from user data, evidence of proactive AI suggestions or recommendations, plan availability details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
